warn.detail: UCI fold 2 has E_alpha 453.96 against E_gate 45.26, a tenfold gap, and alone gives +90.0%. Dropping it leaves a mean of 11.70% instead of 37.81%. The static alpha collapses there; the gate's apparent skill is that collapse, not routing.

Fold-level mean is +0.123% but the cross-fitted aggregate is -0.506% with CI [-1.07%, +0.09%]. The verdict rule reads fold means, which weight three folds equally; the aggregate weights origins. On the dataset that was the primary external confirmation, the aggregate says the gate loses.

Every ADI quartile on UCI has a negative mean per-origin improvement (-35.6%, -50.0%, -114.0%, -258.7%) while the aggregate is strongly positive. A handful of origins with enormous static error carry the whole result.
Aggregate CIs exclude zero on M5 and UCI only. Favorita and FreshRetailNet cover zero, and UCI is the artifact above, so M5's +0.78% is the one clean CI-clear result.
FreshRetailNet and UCI supply three validation folds, not the five targeted; their train regions are 658 and 627 days against M5's 1829.
No existing TEST was scored. EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_NOT_REPLICATED stands unchanged.
